CustomField.description: Formula used to display the combination of the Value Type and Amount
CustomField.formula: IF(TEXT(QCC_Value_Type__c) == "Qantas Points", "PTS " + TEXT(QCC_Amount__c), IF(TEXT(QCC_Value_Type__c) == "Currency", TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) + " " + TEXT(QCC_Amount__c), ""))
CustomField.label: Value
